prior_summary: Use a learned causal relational condition encoder with masked five-phase auxiliary supervision while diffusing absolute world Cartesian targets for nominal-calibration stage ambiguity.
applicable_conditions: Prefer at nominal cabinet calibration when drawer progress, finger state, TCP/red geometry and motion cues are reliable but entry may occur before or after release or red contact. Predicted phase is not contact proof.
termination_guidance: Switch after opening/exposure for an early red_transfer handoff or after observed red/TCP upward co-motion for the nominal handoff. Stop/replan if actions conflict with physical phase cues.
limitations: Absolute world targets are vulnerable to cabinet displacement. Index-derived successful-occurrence phases do not cover unseen failure states. The classifier has no contact truth and cannot prove drawer acquisition or red grasp.
